Decadent Chocolate Protein Muffins
By: Cheryl Dowling
Published: Monday, February 23, 2015 - 6:28pm

Ingredients




2 ripe bananas, peeled
1 cup natural smooth peanut butter
¼ cup unsweetened applesauce
1 teaspoon raw honey
⅓ cup unflavored hemp protein powder
2 teaspoons baking powder
½ teaspoon sea salt
2 tablespoons cocoa powder
2 whole eggs
2 tablespoons ground flax seed

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 400 degrees. 2 Spray a muffin pan with non-stick baking oil or line with muffin tins. 3 Thaw and mash bananas in a bowl until smooth. Add all other ingredients except the optional toppings. Blend until completely smooth. 4 Sprinkle muffins with the optional toppings: chocolate chips, hemp seed, chia seed, or other toppings of your choice. 5 Bake for 18-20 minutes. 6 Cool and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.

About

Just because you eat healthy, doesn’t mean food has to taste healthy. That’s where these decadent wonders come in. With their mousse-like centre and creamy chocolate banana taste, they will leave you satisfied, without the guilt.
Loaded with nutrients, they make a great snack or breakfast for the whole family. I also enjoy them as a post-workout protein meal instead of a shake to switch it up!
Free of gluten, dairy, soy, and refined sugars
Recipe Type: Breakfast, Snack
Preparation Time: 5 minutes
Bake Time: 18-20 minutes
